# crosswork_aaa_tacacs_servers (Resource)

This resource can manage the TACACS+ servers used for authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_aaa_tacacs_servers" "example" {
  servers = [
    {
      host               = "192.0.2.10"
      port               = 49
      secret_wo          = "AAASecret"
      secret_wo_version  = 1
      secret_format      = "ascii"
      service            = "crosswork"
      priority           = 30
      retransmit_timeout = 10
      retries            = 3
      auth_type          = "pap"
      interface          = "192.0.2.1"
      policy_id          = "role0"
      virtual_domain     = "deviceAccessGroups"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `servers` (Attributes List) TACACS+ servers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `host` (String) IP address or host name of the server
- `priority` (Number) Order of the server among all remote authentication servers
- `service` (String) TACACS+ service name to request

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type
  - Choices: `pap`, `chap`
  - Default value: `pap`
- `interface` (String) Interface IP address Crosswork uses to reach the server
- `policy_id` (String) Key name of the role on the server
- `port` (Number) Port of the server
  - Default value: `49`
- `retransmit_timeout` (Number) Retransmit timeout in seconds
- `retries` (Number) Number of retries before the request fails
  - Default value: `0`
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Shared secret
  - **Required**: exactly one of `secret` and `secret_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `secret_wo` together with `secret_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `secret_format` (String) Format of the shared secret
  - Choices: `ascii`, `hex`
  - Default value: `ascii`
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Shared secret
  - **Required**: exactly one of `secret` and `secret_wo` must be set.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `secret_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.
- `virtual_domain` (String) Device access group attribute
  - Default value: `deviceAccessGroups`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_aaa_tacacs_servers.example "aaa_tacacs_servers"
```
